parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular cover made of stainless steel, fitting on top of the kettle to retain heat and prevent spillage.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the kettle to maintain internal pressure and temperature while boiling water, and can be removed for filling or cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched component made of heat-resistant plastic, attached to the top of the kettle for safe handling.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and pour the kettle without direct contact with the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel, designed to hold and heat water.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary vessel for boiling water, distributing heat evenly across its surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except when lifted by the handle for pouring.
